tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground for channels, studio and admin. shadcn --background.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text, headlines and the wordmark ink, on background, card and muted (≥15:1 both themes).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, panels, dialogs. In light, cards separate by border, not shade.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, command palette.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The action colour is black (white in dark): primary buttons, active nav, selected states. Black and white do the work; the pop is kept for emphasis.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Grey. Secondary buttons, segmented-control track, tag fills.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet grey fills: table headers, empty states, transcript panel, skeletons.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Metadata, bylines, captions, helper text. On background, card and muted (≥6:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn hover and highlighted-row fill. Not a brand colour.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card outlines, dividers. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form control borders (≥3:1 on background in both themes).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Black in light, white in dark; the pop is too light to mark focus on white.

tokens.name: pop-start
tokens.usage: Pitch start stop (lime).

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Pitch's middle stop (mint) and its solid stand-in where a gradient can't render. A fill only: on white it is too light for text or small marks (1.5:1), so use pop-ink there.

tokens.name: pop-end
tokens.usage: Pitch end stop (electric blue).

tokens.name: pop-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on Pitch or any pop fill. Always black: ≥8.8:1 on every stop.

tokens.name: pop-ink
tokens.usage: The pop as a small mark on light grounds: chart lines, the LIVE dot, kicker squares, progress, selected-state ticks (3.1:1 on white). Mint in dark. Not for body text.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Fixed black for brand moments in both themes: the cover, marketing heroes, sign-in, social tiles.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Fixed white for the wordmark and headlines on brand-black.

tokens.name: brand-grey
tokens.usage: Fixed dark grey for blocks and panels on brand-black.

tokens.name: brand-muted
tokens.usage: Fixed grey for secondary text on brand-black (7.8:1).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete, takedown, failed import, form errors. Deeper and redder than the pop so the two never read as one. Always with a word.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive fill.

tokens.name: ad-frame
tokens.usage: The ground inside every ad frame, a step off the page so the unit reads as separate without a shadow.

tokens.name: ad-label
tokens.usage: The Advertisement, Sponsored or Presented by label.

gradient.note: Pitch is the brand's radiant moment: lime to mint to electric blue. It sings on black, so marketing heroes and sign-in lean dark. Use it once or twice a screen.

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Logo full stop, monogram tile, pop button, Exclusive badge, marketing hero panels, progress fills on dark. Text on it is always black.

tokens.name: pitch-soft
tokens.usage: A tinted wash behind feature panels and studio empty states. Text on it follows the page's own text tokens.

tokens.name: pitch-glow
tokens.usage: Ambient glow at the top of dark marketing heroes and sign-in. Never behind body text columns.
